task_description: Agents collaborate to gather information from various online sources, synthesize it to form a coherent research report on the impact of renewable energy adoption in urban areas.
expected_outcome: The agents should collect accurate data from designated sources, reconcile conflicting information, ensure correct source attribution, and compile a comprehensive research report.

agents.description: Responsible for gathering information from designated online databases and news sites about renewable energy.
Combines data collected by other agents, resolves conflicts, and ensures accuracy.
Takes synthesized information and constructs a coherent research report, ensuring all sources are correctly attributed.
